blocks.prompt: 4 Find how many ways there are to choose vowel words from the letter of English alphabet?
blocks.explanation:
Kitab mein sawal ke alfaaz saaf nahi ("vowel words"). Answer key 65,780 deti hai, jo \({}^{26}C_{5}\) hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke asal sawal yeh hai: 26 letters mein se 5 letters (jitne vowels hote hain) kitne tareeqon se chune ja sakte hain.
Find kya karna hai? In selections ki ginti.
Plan: order ki ahmiyat nahi, is liye \({}^{26}C_{5}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: English alphabet ke 26 letters (A se Z). Vowels 5 hain (A, E, I, O, U), is liye 5 letters chunne hain.
Humein find karna hai: 26 mein se 5 letters chunne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Sirf yeh dekhna hai ke kaunse letters chune gaye, un ki tarteeb nahi. Is liye combination \({}^{n}C_{r}\), jahan \(n = 26\) aur \(r = 5\).

Combination likhein
\[{}^{26}C_{5} = \dfrac{26!}{5!\,21!}\]
\[= \dfrac{26 \cdot 25 \cdot 24 \cdot 23 \cdot 22}{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
Kyun: \(26!\) ko \(21!\) tak khola to neeche ka \(21!\) cancel ho gaya. Upar ab sirf 5 factors bache: 26 se neeche ki taraf paanch numbers.

Multiply karne se pehle cancel karein
\[\dfrac{25}{5} = 5,\quad \dfrac{24}{4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2} = 1\]
\[= 26 \cdot 5 \cdot 23 \cdot 22\]
Kyun: Pehle cancel karne se numbers chhote rehte hain aur calculator ke baghair bhi hisaab aasaan ho jata hai. Neeche ka 5, upar ke 25 ko 5 bana deta hai, aur \(4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 = 24\) upar ke 24 ko poora kha jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Pehle upar ke paanchon numbers multiply kar ke phir 120 se divide karna bhi sahi hai, lekin bare number mein ghalti ka khatra zyada hai.

Multiply karein
\[26 \cdot 5 = 130,\quad 130 \cdot 23 = 2990\]
\[2990 \cdot 22 = 65780\]
Kyun: Do do numbers multiply kar ke aage barhte hain, is tarah har qadam check ho sakta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[26 \cdot 25 \cdot 24 \cdot 23 \cdot 22 = 7893600\]
\[7893600 \div 120 = 65780 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Lamba tareeqa bhi wahi jawab deta hai, aur yeh answer key se bhi milta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein sawal ke alfaaz ('choose vowel words from the letter of English alphabet') saaf nahi hain. Answer key 65,780 deti hai jo \({}^{26}C_{5}\) ke barabar hai, is liye asal sawal yeh hai: English alphabet ke 26 letters mein se 5 letters (jitne vowels hain) kitne tareeqon se chune ja sakte hain? Humne yahi sawal hal kiya hai.
